svg.title: Crypto Idea — frontend layered architecture
svg.desc: The src/ tree is layered with a one-direction dependency rule: components (UI only) call hooks (business logic and state), which call api/ (data fetching only); everything uses utils/ (pure helpers). The app shell wraps its render in an AppContext provider so screens read shared state via useApp() instead of dozens of props. The Research tab is a self-contained vertical slice with its own api/hooks/components/utils/styles and scoped CSS. data/ holds reference content and styles/ the design system. The layering is being peeled out incrementally; some logic still lives in the shell.
svg.text: Frontend Layered Architecture (src/)
One-way dependency: components → hooks → api/ · everything → utils/ (pure)
core layer
entries / feature slice
src/ root — Vite entries + app shell
main.jsx → app.html (user router) · admin-main.jsx → admin.html (separate) · CryptoIdea.jsx — shell wraps render in <AppContext.Provider>
components/ — UI only (presentational JSX) · 19
Portfolio · Search · AddEntry · Detail · Account · Login · admin-dashboard · ui.jsx
read shared state via useApp() · NEVER fetch / import the Firebase SDK
hooks/ — business logic + state (React, no JSX) · 9
useAuthSession · usePortfolios · useUpgrade · useLivePrices · useCoinSearch · useCoinHistory
useLearn · useAdminDashboard · app-context (AppContext + useApp)

firebase-auth · firebase-database · coingecko · config · account · admin · firebase.config
the only layer that talks to Firebase / the backend proxy
utils/ — pure helpers (no React, no I/O) · 10 · used by EVERY layer
format · coins · pnl · journal · learn · trash · usage · export-csv · storage · theme
same input → same output → trivially unit-testable (where the math lives)
calls
calls

self-contained: its OWN
api / hooks / components / utils / styles
CSS scoped under .research-root (can't leak)
app-native data only — no new external calls

.research-root (both reuse generic class names)
Why it's built this way
• One-way dependency: a component that needs data calls a HOOK; the hook calls api/ and uses utils/. Components never fetch() or import the Firebase SDK.
• Pure utils = testable core: utils/ has no React and no I/O, so the real logic (pnl, coins, learn, journal) is unit-tested directly without rendering or mocks.
• AppContext over prop-drilling: the shell wraps render in <AppContext.Provider>; extracted screens read shared state/handlers via useApp() instead of 25+ props each.
• Feature slices stay isolated: the Research tab owns its api/hooks/components/utils/styles with scoped CSS, so it evolves (or is deleted) without rippling into the core.
• KISS, incremental: existing code is peeled into these layers one verified commit at a time — not a big-bang rewrite; the test net guards each extraction.
Migration status (honest — src/ARCHITECTURE.md §"Known layer violations")
CryptoIdea.jsx still holds portfolio-CRUD + upgrade handlers (coupled to UI/auth by design); api/ also runs counter/limit logic (really a data/model layer);
admin-dashboard.jsx calls Cloud Functions directly (→ future api/admin.js). The rules above are the target the migration is closing toward.
Source: src/ARCHITECTURE.md · src/{api,hooks,components,utils,data,styles,features}/ · src/hooks/app-context.js (AppContext / useApp).
